rv.q: Tom Hollander’s Berezovsky is a genie just let out of a bottle: squirming, stretching, roaring, carrying on multiple conversations.
Yes, Peter Morgan’s excellent play is instructive and thoroughly absorbing.
The contrast in physical energy between the men is enthralling.
It makes for an exhilarating contrast with the boundless energy of Hollander, who careens like a walking pinball over Miriam Buether’s brick-faced set.

The Almeida’s latest power drama to transfer to the West End sees Tom Hollander reprise his role as Russian oligarch Boris Berezovsky and Will Keen as Vladimir Putin in Peter Morgan’s PATRIOTS which has landed at the Noël Coward Theatre for a limited 12 week run.
Regardless, it’s riveting from start to finish.

cn.t: Morgan's timely drama about Putin's rise through oligarch Berezovsky's eyes earns strong reviews for its urgent relevance and vivid production, offering compelling insight into modern Russia's power dynamics.
